instruction: `word_counts(text)` counts words case-sensitively and keeps punctuation attached. Fix it: lowercase everything and strip leading/trailing punctuation (characters in string.punctuation) from each word; drop words that become empty. Then add `top_n(text, n)` returning a list of (word, count) tuples sorted by count descending, ties broken alphabetically, at most n items (n <= 0 gives []).
